parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description: The database ID. This parameter is optional. If specified, the Q&A is performed within the specified database. If not specified, the Q&A is performed at the tenant level across all databases. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to obtain the database ID.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The name of the model to use. Only Qwen series models are supported.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The natural language question from the user.

parameters.name: QueryId
parameters.description: The request ID for the current Q&A round. This value is used in the requestId field of SSE events.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID. This parameter is used to associate context across multiple conversation rounds.
